hover-card-open-delay.$description: How long the pointer or keyboard focus rests on a HoverCard's trigger before the card opens. Longer than a Tooltip's, so passing over a link doesn't flash a card.

hover-card-close-delay.$description: Grace time after the pointer leaves the trigger or card before a HoverCard closes, so the pointer can cross the gap into the card (WCAG 1.4.13, hoverable).

hover-card-width.$description: Width of a HoverCard; it narrows to fit the screen.
